hotels.title: Boutique Hills District Retreat at Peppers The Hills Lodge
hotels.description: Set in Sydney’s leafy Hills District, this boutique manor-style retreat pairs Tudor-inspired architecture with manicured gardens, just moments from Norwest Business Park and the lakeside dining of Norwest Quay. Castle Hill Country Club and the boutiques, cinemas and restaurants of Castle Towers are within easy reach. Onsite, guests can dine on modern Australian fare at Nobles Restaurant or settle into the cosy atmosphere of the heritage-style bar. A heated indoor pool, spa and sauna add a polished touch, and nearby Bella Vista Farm offers a glimpse into the region’s colonial past
